description: Owner: integration (T10). Causa's release-set decision record (AR-023, VER-001, VER-002, VER-003, VER-005). The locked set is .echelon/dependency-lock.json, a byte-for-byte copy of the governed lock (kemiller2002/Indy-init docs/competition-readiness/dependency-lock.json, the file kickoff/competition/toolchain.lock.json pins by sha256). This record adds what the lock does not carry: per system, whether Causa actually integrates it, its owner and release channel, the freshness checks against authoritative release sources (checked timestamp, candidate, source, reason), the compatibility evidence, and every exception or prerelease approval. Causa.Acceptance.Deterministic.VER00*Tests verify this record against the lock and against what the repository declares.
